subject.title: fix(windows): remove findstr from restart probe

question: Should this protected Windows restart PR wait for native Windows Task Scheduler proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for the source/test-only fix?
rationale: The code path affects Windows restart availability, and the PR body says native proof will be added, but source review cannot prove the reported no-window/no-hang behavior on a real host.

options.title: Wait for native proof
options.body: Require redacted Windows Task Scheduler, terminal, desktop, or log proof that the helper completes without findstr and the Gateway restarts successfully.

options.title: Override source-only risk
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the source/test evidence without live Windows proof, owning any unproven restart or windowing behavior.

recommendation.title: Wait for native proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted Windows Task Scheduler, terminal, desktop, or log proof that the helper completes without findstr and the Gateway restarts successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is a maintainer replacement authored by steipete, who also has recent adjacent Windows restart logging history.
